meta.title: Deleting a line item on a draft sets it inactive

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with one line item and no rounds.
steps: The buyer sends the request that updates (and publishes) the event, the request the case itself writes.
As the buyer, read the event and check that Data check: “status” equals in_active.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Data check: “status” equals in_active.
